resources.string: HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy through this phone. Connect the other device to the phone’s hotspot or the same Wi-Fi, then configure its proxy. Apply changes to the running VPN.
Enable the hotspot or connect to Wi-Fi, then reopen this screen.

On Windows: Network & Internet → Proxy → Manual proxy: phone address and port below. For Telegram Desktop, use SOCKS5 in Telegram’s proxy settings. Enter the username and password below when prompted. Only applications configured to use this proxy will share the connection. VPN must remain connected.
OpenConnect only: route private addresses to the remote router, overriding private-range bypass. Enabled by default. Turn off to use the phone’s local network instead. Does not enable VPN sharing.
